zh.title: 让 AI 按按钮，谁来读网页？
zh.takeaway: 程序读网页并列出按钮，Jev 选下一步；需要填写文字时，再交给文字模型。
zh.limit: 结果来自整套工具配合，不能把全部能力都归给 Jev。

en.title: An AI clicks. Who reads the page?
en.takeaway: Code reads the page and lists controls; Jev picks an action. A text model helps when words need to be entered.
en.limit: The result depends on the whole system, not Jev alone.

zh.title: 不写页面，能不能拼出界面？
zh.takeaway: 像搭积木：Jev 选择组件、安排关系，程序将结果装配成可以渲染的界面。
zh.limit: 结构合法，不代表内容正确或设计好看。

en.title: Can choices become an interface?
en.takeaway: Like building with blocks: Jev selects components and relationships; code assembles a renderable interface.
en.limit: A valid structure does not guarantee correct content or good design.

zh.title: 视频里的口播广告，怎么跳过？
zh.takeaway: Jev 在字幕中找赞助内容，程序把对应句子换算成播放时间，再执行跳转。
zh.limit: 字幕与边界判断都可能出错，音频模式还需要语音转写。

en.title: How do you skip a spoken sponsor segment?
en.takeaway: Jev identifies sponsor content in captions; code maps those lines to playback times and skips ahead.
en.limit: Captions and segment boundaries can be wrong; audio mode also needs transcription.

zh.title: 解开魔方，靠判断还是公式？
zh.takeaway: 公式预先写在代码里，Jev 识别当前属于哪种情况，程序查公式并检查操作。
zh.limit: 这是模型与解法代码合作，不能当成模型独立发明了解法。

en.title: Solving a cube: judgment or formulas?
en.takeaway: The formulas live in code. Jev recognizes the current situation; code selects a formula and checks the moves.
en.limit: This is model-and-code teamwork, not evidence that the model invented the solution.

zh.title: 一叠表格，怎样分清每一页？
zh.takeaway: 程序提取页面文字，Jev 判断表格类型；拿不准的页面留下来复核。
zh.limit: 作者公开了测试结果，但这不等于所有格式都能可靠识别。

en.title: What kind of form is each page?
en.takeaway: Code extracts page text; Jev identifies the form type. Uncertain pages are held for review.
en.limit: The author publishes test results, which do not establish reliability on every format.

zh.title: 简单任务，需要最强的模型吗？
zh.takeaway: 像工单分诊：Jev 判断任务难度，插件据此选择子代理模型和主会话推理力度。
zh.limit: 路由机制可查，实际省多少钱、是否影响质量仍待验证。

en.title: Does every task need the strongest model?
en.takeaway: Like ticket triage: Jev judges task difficulty, and a plugin chooses subagent models and main-session reasoning effort.
en.limit: The routing mechanism is inspectable; real savings and quality effects remain unverified.

zh.title: 操作网页与电脑
zh.intro: 从查网页到操作桌面，关键是把“看见什么”和“下一步做什么”接起来。浏览器方案多读页面结构，桌面方案可能用无障碍树或 OCR；先比较能完成哪些任务，再看速度。

en.title: Operate browsers and computers
en.intro: These systems connect observation to action. Browser tools often read page structure; desktop tools may use accessibility trees or OCR. Compare task coverage before speed.

zh.title: 给任务挑选助手
zh.intro: 模型、技能和工具各有擅长的工作，Jev 负责分派。选模型影响费用与质量，选技能影响能否找到合适能力；两者可以组合。

en.title: Choose an assistant for the task
en.intro: Models, skills and tools serve different needs; Jev helps assign work. Model routing affects cost and quality, while skill routing finds capabilities. The two can work together.

zh.title: 检查代码与操作风险
zh.intro: 把宽泛的“有没有问题”拆成几个具体判断。代码评审找缺陷，权限判断管操作；少误报和不漏报都要看，评分不能替代测试。

en.title: Check code and risky actions
en.intro: Break a broad review into specific judgments. Code review looks for defects; permission checks govern actions. Both false alarms and missed problems matter, and scores do not replace tests.

zh.title: 整理文件与信息
zh.intro: 给邮件贴标签、识别表格、挑出相关文件，都是把杂乱信息整理成可用结果。分类、检索和数值估算的错误不同，不能用一张速度榜衡量。

en.title: Organize files and information
en.intro: Label emails, identify forms or find relevant files. Classification, retrieval and numerical estimates fail in different ways; one speed ranking cannot compare them fairly.

zh.title: 读懂内容与传播
zh.intro: 有的工具给广告贴标签，有的分析文章关联或预测传播。描述内容与预测未来是两回事；高评分也不保证流量或引用。

en.title: Analyze content and reach
en.intro: Some tools label ads; others connect articles or predict reach. Describing content differs from predicting the future, and a high score does not guarantee traffic or citations.

zh.title: 过滤不想看的内容
zh.intro: 把“我不想看到什么”变成可执行的筛选规则。信息流过滤判断帖子，网页清理判断元素，视频跳过判断时间段；各自都要能纠正误判。

en.title: Filter unwanted content
en.intro: Turn preferences into filtering rules. Feed tools judge posts, page cleaners judge elements, and video tools locate time segments. Each needs a way to correct mistakes.

zh.title: 帮 AI 留住有用记忆
zh.intro: 对话变长后，哪些信息值得留下？这些工具分别选择何时压缩、压缩什么、召回什么；节省字数之后，仍要检查任务能否继续做好。

en.title: Help AI keep useful context
en.intro: As conversations grow, what should stay? These tools decide when to compact, what to keep or what to retrieve. Fewer tokens are useful only if later work still succeeds.

zh.title: 玩游戏与解谜
zh.intro: 把游戏状态变成可选动作，就能观察一连串小判断怎样影响结果。有的只选动作，有的配合规划器或现成解法；流畅演示不等于高水平通关。

en.title: Play games and solve puzzles
en.intro: Turn game state into choices and watch small decisions add up. Some systems only select actions; others use planners or predefined solutions. Smooth footage does not establish strong play.

zh.title: 在模拟世界里做实验
zh.intro: 从交通灯、机器人到虚构角色，在沙盘里观察决策的影响。物理与运动通常由程序处理；模拟成功之后，还需要验证现实中的表现。

en.title: Experiment in simulated worlds
en.intro: Explore decisions in traffic, robotics and virtual characters. Code usually handles physics and movement. Success in a simulation still needs validation in the real world.

zh.title: 把判断变成交互
zh.intro: 选择一个颜色、一个组件，或判断一句话是否需要回应，小判断也能组成新界面。不同作品分别看语义、结构和误触发，不能只比响应快慢。

en.title: Turn judgments into interactions
en.intro: Choose a color or component, or decide whether speech needs a response. Small judgments can create new interfaces. Compare meaning, structure and false activations as well as latency.

zh.title: 研究交易与历史回测
zh.intro: 一类在过去行情上试策略，一类展示交易执行。回测要检查数据时序，执行要核对成交与风控；跑得快、费用低都不证明能盈利。

en.title: Explore trading and backtests
en.intro: Some examples test strategies on historical data; others demonstrate execution. Backtests need time-valid data, while execution needs fill and risk checks. Speed and low cost do not establish profit.
